generator.module_tree:
StyleGAN2ResnetGenerator(
  (SpatialCodeModulation): GeneratorModulation(
    (scale): EqualLinear(2048, 8)
    (bias): EqualLinear(2048, 8)
  )
  (HeadResnetBlock0): ResolutionPreservingResnetBlock(
    (conv1): StyledConv(
      (conv): ModulatedConv2d(8, 128, 3, upsample=False, downsample=False)
      (noise): NoiseInjection()
      (activate): FusedLeakyReLU()
    )
    (conv2): StyledConv(
      (conv): ModulatedConv2d(128, 128, 3, upsample=False, downsample=False)
      (noise): NoiseInjection()
      (activate): FusedLeakyReLU()
    )
    (skip): ConvLayer(
      (Conv): EqualConv2d(8, 128, 1, stride=1, padding=0)
    )
  )
  (HeadResnetBlock1): ResolutionPreservingResnetBlock(
    (conv1): StyledConv(
      (conv): ModulatedConv2d(128, 256, 3, upsample=False, downsample=False)
      (noise): NoiseInjection()
      (activate): FusedLeakyReLU()
    )
    (conv2): StyledConv(
      (conv): ModulatedConv2d(256, 256, 3, upsample=False, downsample=False)
      (noise): NoiseInjection()
      (activate): FusedLeakyReLU()
    )
    (skip): ConvLayer(
      (Conv): EqualConv2d(128, 256, 1, stride=1, padding=0)
    )
  )
  (UpsamplingResBlock16): UpsamplingResnetBlock(
    (conv1): StyledConv(
      (conv): ModulatedConv2d(256, 128, 3, upsample=True, downsample=False)
      (noise): NoiseInjection()
      (activate): FusedLeakyReLU()
    )
    (conv2): StyledConv(
      (conv): ModulatedConv2d(128, 128, 3, upsample=False, downsample=False)
      (noise): NoiseInjection()
      (activate): FusedLeakyReLU()
    )
    (skip): ConvLayer(
      (Conv): EqualConv2d(256, 128, 1, stride=1, padding=0)
      (Act): FusedLeakyReLU()
    )
  )
  (ToRGB): ToRGB(
    (upsample): Upsample()
    (conv): ModulatedConv2d(128, 3, 1, upsample=False, downsample=False)
  )
)
